$schema_note: Provenance record for a root schema.sql extraction from the verified published dump. Status: DEFERRED. No schema.sql exists at the repository root and none was fabricated.
target_artifact: schema.sql at the repository root only (not inside docs/release-1.0.1/)

reasons: The spec's allowed decoder invocations run pg_restore 18.6 inside the existing ml01a-pg18 container via privileged container execution, which the dispatching authorization denies in this run; the deferral lane is explicit for unavailable optional dump decoding.
No pg_restore client exists on the host PATH (checked 2026-11-13, 'which pg_restore' exit 1) and none can be installed without privileged operations denied in this run.
Acquiring the 7,204,002,678-byte package without any decoder would verify bytes but could not produce the extraction, so the single 15-minute lane attempt was not spent.
deferral.unblock_conditions: A run with an authorized decoder (container path or installed client) acquires the package, verifies bytes against the provider size/checksum, computes SHA-256, and extracts schema-only output with deterministic bytes; the extractor version, arguments, source package member and output hash are then recorded here and the two superseded schema documents are pointed at the extracted root schema.sql.

superseded_docs: docs/postgresql-database-schema.md — superseded in place; points to docs/release-1.0.1/known-limitations.md for the deferral explanation
steam-dataset-2025-v1/DATA_DICTIONARY.md — superseded in place; same pointer
affected_public_statements.no_schema_claims: No bootstrap or restore guarantee is advertised anywhere in this repository. No SQL in any package has been executed or validated by this maintenance unit.

extraction_contract_when_unblocked.source_version_note: Source PostgreSQL/pg_dump versions of the published dump must be distinguished from the extraction tool version and any generated preamble.
extraction_contract_when_unblocked.determinism: Repeated extraction from the same package bytes must produce identical output bytes; the output SHA-256 is recorded here.
extraction_contract_when_unblocked.no_execution: Extracted SQL is never executed by this program; a restore smoke test is later program work.
